newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Noranda Inc ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Noranda Inc ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Monday that it confirmed the ratings on all series of Noranda Inc's senior debentures at BBB (high) with a stable trend.

The Toronto-based ratings agency said it confirmed its rating for Noranda's convertible subordinated debentures at BBB with a stable trend, preferred shares at Pfd-3 with a stable trend and commercial paper at R-1 (low) with a stable trend.

Dominion said the ratings recognized Noranda's balance sheet strength. It said the mining, energy and forestry company was diverse enough to weather instability in one of its primary business sectors and had current capital investments that were expected to contribute to long-term profitability.
